title: Series 140 datasheet

body:
Pressure-temperature: 2,000 psi CWP to 100 °F, 1,150 psi at 400 °F (stainless).

Weights from 1.1 lb (1/4 in) to 46 lb (4 in).

title: Series 140 installation, operation and maintenance
summary: How to install, operate and reseal the Series 140 in line.
body: Swing-out service: loosen all body bolts, remove two, swing the center section out. Replace seats and body seals, torque in a cross pattern to the values in table 4.

title: Choosing a butterfly valve: resilient or high-performance
summary: A short guide to picking between the Series 210 and 260.
body: Choose resilient-seated for water and HVAC under 200 psi. Choose high-performance when you need Class 300, temperatures above 250 °F or tight shutoff on hydrocarbons.

title: 2027 distributor price sheet, pumps and actuators
summary: List prices and multipliers for pumps and actuators.
body: Actuator list prices are unchanged for 2027. Pump list prices rise 2.8%.

title: Series 420 CAD package (STEP and DWG)
summary: 3D STEP models and 2D DWG drawings for every Series 420 size and class.
body: Package version 4 adds the 8 in Class 600 body and the anti-cavitation bonnet.

title: Stock program and consignment terms
summary: How the stocking program, consignment inventory and quarterly returns work.
body: Stocking distributors may return up to 5% of the prior quarter's purchases in new condition, freight paid.

title: SB-2026-04: Series 420 bonnet bolt torque update
summary: Revised bonnet bolt torque for Class 600 bodies built before serial 42-26-1100.
body: Increase bonnet bolt torque on Class 600 bodies from 210 to 240 ft·lb, in three passes, cross pattern. Applies to serials below 42-26-1100. Replace bolts with grade B7M on sour service.

title: SB-2026-03: PRA-50 low-temperature seal kit
summary: New seal kit for actuators in service below -4 °F.
body: Kit K-050-LT replaces nitrile O-rings with fluorosilicone. Order by actuator size.

title: Field repair procedure: Series 260 seat replacement
summary: Step-by-step seat replacement with the valve out of line, including the fire-safe backup.
body: Remove the retainer ring screws, lift the retainer, remove the seat. Clean the seat pocket; inspect the disc edge for scoring deeper than 0.002 in.

title: Pump test loop acceptance checklist
summary: What a witnessed test at Linnmoor covers, and how to read the test record.
body: Witnessed tests record flow, head, power and vibration at five points from shutoff to 120% of best efficiency.
